title: Review short_id vs appropriate_length_id: unify ID display
description:
short_id() always returns 8 chars. appropriate_length_id() returns minimum unambiguous prefix (3+ chars). Currently only 'pebbles new' uses appropriate_length_id, while list/show/epic use short_id.

Review all uses of short_id and determine if they could use the shorter appropriate_length_id instead. If so, make short_id behave like appropriate_length_id and remove the separate function.

Considerations:
- Shorter IDs are easier to type and remember
- Need to ensure IDs remain unambiguous in all contexts
- May need to pass Operations/index to places that currently just use Issue.short_id()
